title: China shows leadership with Iran; US no interest
description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — China is stepping up its diplomacy on the Iran war, putting forward a five-point proposal with Pakistan, rallying support from Gulf countries, and opposing a United Nations proposal to use any force necessary to open the Strait of Hormuz.

title: What are 'teapot' refineries? China's secret weapon against global oil crisis | EXPLAINED
description: As war disrupts global energy markets, Beijing's network of small, scrappy oil refineries is quietly keeping the lights on, for now. When the United States and Israel launched strikes on Iran on 28 February, and Tehran responded within hours by blocking the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow waterway through which roughly a fifth of the world's oil and gas flows, panic swept through energy markets. Brent crude surged past $116 a barrel earlier this week, and countries worldwide scrambled to tap strategic reserves.

title: UN Hormuz vote now expected next week; China opposes authorisation of force
description: NEW YORK: The United Nations Security Council is now expected to vote next week on a Bahraini resolution to protect commercial shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz, diplomats said on Friday (April 3), but veto-wielding China has made clear its opposition to authorising any use of force.

title: West Asia Crisis: Seventh LPG Tanker Reaches India, But 17 Ships Remain Stranded
description: As West Asia tensions disrupt shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, a seventh LPG tanker reaches India while 17 vessels remain stranded. An Iranian crude tanker diverts last minute to China, even as India eyes its first Iranian oil import since 2019 and ramps up efforts to secure fuel and LPG supplies

title: China aims to show global leadership with Iran war diplomacy. US appears uninterested
description: China is actively pursuing a diplomatic role in the Iran war. It has proposed a five-point plan with Pakistan and is seeking support from Gulf nations. China opposes a UN proposal for military action to open the Strait of Hormuz. The United States shows little interest in China's mediation efforts.

title: China and Pakistan propose ceasefire plan for Iran, push to reopen Strait of Hormuz
description: China and Pakistan unveiled a five-point peace plan to de-escalate tensions in Iran and restore safe navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global oil chokepoint.
